//! @generated — resolusi nilai. Mengubah teks `{{key}}`, state, dan aset
//! menjadi nilai konkret yang bisa dikirim ke renderer.

use crate::component::{Asset, Paint, State, WidgetSpec};
use crate::core::Color;

/// Ganti semua `{{key}}` dengan nilai dari `State`. Key yang tidak ada
/// dibiarkan apa adanya supaya mudah dilihat saat debugging.
pub fn text(raw: &str, state: &State) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(raw.len());
    let mut rest = raw;
    while let Some(start) = rest.find("{{") {
        out.push_str(&rest[..start]);
        let after = &rest[start + 2..];
        match after.find("}}") {
            Some(end) => {
                let key = &after[..end];
                match state.text(key) {
                    Some(value) => out.push_str(&value),
                    None => out.push_str(&rest[start..start + 2 + end + 2]),
                }
                rest = &after[end + 2..];
            }
            None => {
                out.push_str(&rest[start..]);
                return out;
            }
        }
    }
    out.push_str(rest);
    out
}

/// Teks yang ditampilkan sebuah widget: binding state mengalahkan label desain.
pub fn widget_label(spec: &WidgetSpec, state: &State) -> String {
    if let Some(key) = &spec.binding {
        if let Some(value) = state.text(key) {
            if !value.is_empty() {
                return value;
            }
        }
    }
    spec.label
        .as_deref()
        .map(|label| text(label, state))
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

pub fn fill_color(paint: Option<&Paint>) -> Option<Color> {
    match paint {
        Some(Paint::Solid(color)) => Some(*color),
        Some(Paint::Unsupported(value)) => Some(value.fallback),
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub fn image_bytes(paint: Option<&Paint>, assets: &[Asset]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let id = match paint {
        Some(Paint::Image(id)) => *id,
        _ => return None,
    };
    assets.iter().find(|asset| asset.id == id).map(|asset| asset.bytes.clone())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn bindings_are_resolved() {
        let mut state = State::new();
        state.set("name", crate::component::Value::Text("Rust".into()));
        assert_eq!(text("Halo {{name}}!", &state), "Halo Rust!");
        assert_eq!(text("Halo {{missing}}", &state), "Halo {{missing}}");
    }
}
